xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:AnyOtherInformationForDisclosu: As on the date of filing, i.e., 27th January 2026, the litigation with the Assessing Officer, Income Tax Department, for Assessment Year 201718, involving a demand of Rs.46.44 million arising from non-submission of Form 3CL for R&D expenses claimed under Section 35(2AB) and disallowance of deductions under Section 80G, stands resolved. The same was disclosed to the stock exchanges as an update on litigation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations on 17th January 2026.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: As part of the Income Tax Assessment, Company received assessment order u/s 143(3) of the IT Act for AY 2017-18 with a demand of Rs.46.44 Million due to non-submission of FORM 3CL for R&D expenses claimed u/s 35(2AB), deductions not allowed u/s 80G.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The Company has filed an appeal before CIT (Appeals), Income Tax, and is awaiting hearing.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: Commissioner of Central Tax, Bangalore North Division
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Headquarters Preventive Unit, Bangalore II Commissionerate conducted the audit for period from the 2009-10 to 2014-15 and indicated that the company has not paid service tax under reverse charge on the expenses incurred in the foreign currency towards selling and marketing office situated aboard. The quantum of claims is amounting to Rs.52.61 million.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The Company has filed an appeal before CESTAT and awaiting hearing.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: Commissioner of Central Tax, Bangalore North Division
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Headquarters Preventive Unit, Bangalore II Commissionerate conducted the audit for period from the 2016-17 to 2017-18 (June 2017) and indicated that the company has not paid service tax under reverse charge on the expenses incurred in the foreign currency towards selling and marketing office situated aboard. The quantum of claims is amounting to Rs.36.73 million.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The Company has filed an appeal before CESTAT and awaiting hearing.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: Assessment order was received by the Company, wherein certain disallowances are proposed by the assessing officer. The demand raised is Rs.4.56 crores (including interest).
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The Company has filed an appeal before High Court and awaiting hearing.
